product.name: Amazon Brand - Ravenna Home Vintage Windowpane Metal Mantel Mirror, 25"H, Gold
product.description: 25"H x 20.25"L x 0.75"D Mirrored glass with solid metal decorative frame in a gold finish The windowpane effect of this mirror creates dimension in any space, making it stylish as well as functional. The chic gold color gives this mirror's classic frame a fresh look. Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with a soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware not included. No assembly required.
